data.rationale: The proposal follows the right overall procedure and order (Wikipedia, Booking.com, then Notes) with the right parameters. It misses the "review score of 8 or more" filter by opening just the top-listed hotel, and the "do not click Reserve" constraint is absent. It also adds assumptions that the true workflow doesn't state: a French city, a one-night stay, and a € price. Because of this, an automation built from it would pick the wrong property and could fail on the checkout date.
